publication.plain: Supply positive mass in kilograms and signed initial and final velocities in meters per second with identical nonempty shapes. Receive both kinetic energies and net work in joules. Net work may be negative or zero and is independently rounded from the exact energy difference, not subtracted from the two rounded outputs. This does not certify the path or identify work by an individual force, heat or rotational energy.
